name: diagnostics
description: LSP-style diagnostics after every edit: Python syntax (+ Ruff errors), JSON, JavaScript (node --check) and TypeScript (tsc) problems are returned to the agent so it fixes them immediately.
inspiredBy: OpenCode LSP diagnostics / Claude Code typecheck-after-edit hooks

python.description: Syntax check (+ ruff E9/F63/F7/F82 when ruff is installed)

typescript.description: tsc --noEmit when the project has tsconfig.json and typescript installed
